Exam Date & Time: 09-May-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - APRIL / MAY 2025  
  SUBJECT: MIE 1071/MIE_1071 - BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING  
  BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING [MIE 1071-PHY]  
Marks: 50                                                                            Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          Determine the quantity of heat required in kJ/kg to generate 1 kg of steam at a  
  pressure of 8 bar from water at 30o C.  
  i) When the dryness fraction of steam is 0.9.  
  ii) When steam is dry saturated.                                                  (4)  
  iii) When steam is superheated at constant pressure to 300o C.  
  Assume specific heat of water and superheated steam as 4.187kJ/kg k and 2.25kJ/kg  
  k respectively.  
  
1B)          A boiler generates 6200 kg of steam per hour at 9 bar and 0.93 dryness fraction from  
  feed water at 38oC. When using 825 kg of coal per hour having calorific value of  
  31000 kJ/kg. If preheater is used, which will reduce the coal consumption by 15%,  
  what is the improvement in efficiency?                                               (3)  
  Assume specific heat of water and superheated steam as 4.187kJ/kg K and 2.25kJ/kg  
  k respectively.  
  
1C)          Differentiate between fire-tube and water-tube boilers with examples.  
  (3)  
  
2A)          A flat belt is used to drive a conveyor system in a manufacturing plant by  
  transmitting power between two parallel shafts rotating in opposite directions. The  
  driving pulley has a diameter of 350 mm, and the driven shaft rotates at 200 rpm. The  
  centre distance between the pulleys is 900 mm, and the speed reduction ratio is 4:3.  
  If the initial belt tension is 1600 N, calculate the following:                       (4)  
  i) The tension in the tight and slack sides of the belt.  
  ii) The amount of power transmitted through the belt.  
  iii) The total length of the belt required.  
  Assume a coefficient of friction of 0.30 between the belt and the pulley surface.  
  
2B)          Gears with the following parameters are available. Determine an arrangement to       (3)  
  obtain the maximum possible speed for the driven shaft using compound gear train if  
  the power is to be transmitted using 4 shafts. If the driver gear rotates at 200rpm,  
  determine the speed of the driven shaft. sketch the arrangement of gear train.

2C)             Justify the statements.  
  i) Creep in belt drives reduces power transmission efficiency.  
  ii) In crossed belt drives, the direction of rotation of the driven pulley is opposite to  
  that of the driver pulley.                                                                  (3)  
  iii) In a belt drive system, loose side tension is always kept below the tight side  
  tension.  
  
3A)             Illustrating thermodynamic events explain how the reciprocating motion is  
  transformed into the rotary motion in a prime mover that directly admits the charge         (4)  
  and operates with a compression ratio of 9:1.  
  
3B)             A twin cylinder petrol engine with stroke to bore ratio of 1.5 develops 45 kW at a  
  cam shaft speed of 2800 rpm. The mean effective pressure on the piston is 900kPa  
  and mechanical efficiency is 87 %. Determine (i) the diameter and stroke of each        (3)  
  cylinder and (ii) the brake thermal efficiency, if the fuel consumption is 10 kg/hr and  
  the fuel is having calorific value of 43900 kJ/kg.  
  
3C)             With a neat sketch elucidate the functions of major components of a simple  
  carburetor.                                                                                 (3)  
  
4A)             Suggest and explain with neat sketch a suitable lathe operation which is used to  
  produce a tapered surface on a cylindrical workpiece by aligning the cutting tool at        (4)  
  the required tapered angle.  
  
4B)             "Radial drilling machine is the most versatile drilling machine". Justify with proper  
  reasoning. Also, sketch and explain the radial drilling machine.                            (3)  
  
4C)             Suggest a type of arc welding process which uses non-consumable electrode. Explain  
  in detail the selected welding process.                                            (3)  
  
5A)             Explain the two-box moulding process with a suitable example.  
  (4)  
  
5B)             List the advantages and disadvantages of employing CNC machines.  
  (3)  
  
5C)             Discuss the use of industrial robots in processing and welding applications.  
  (3)  
  
  
-----End-----
